video.title: 5 Jobs You Can Get WITHOUT A College Degree in 2026

summary: The video presents five degree-free career paths: pet care, remote sales, electrical and solar work, digital marketing, and AI automation. It gives suggested learning and entry steps for each, alongside earnings and industry figures that are not independently verified in the transcript. The host also mentions building Casper Capital and growing faceless Instagram pages, but gives little detail about how either was monetised. Most of the featured paths require substantial human work; AI automation consulting has the clearest potential for software-led delivery, though the video does not explain a mostly autonomous operating model.

tactics.name: Build a local dog-care reputation
steps: Create a profile on Rover, Wag, or a community app, using photos and short videos.
Discount the first few walks to earn early reviews.
Use Google Calendar to organise visits and send a short text or photo after each walk.
Invest in leashes, treats, and safety gear; ask satisfied clients for referrals.
Create an Instagram account or website with pet photos and testimonials.
Add overnight sitting or small dog group hikes as capacity grows, and hire help when needed.
Track income and expenses; the host suggests setting up an LLC once the business is steady.

tactics.name: Practise for entry-level remote sales
steps: Study sales psychology and communication using online resources and books.
Use a CRM such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce to track customers.
Apply for sales development representative or appointment setter roles.
Practise daily and record yourself answering common questions to improve under pressure.
Progress toward higher-ticket sales, sales management, or an online sales agency.

tactics.name: Train through an electrical apprenticeship
steps: Apply for an apprenticeship through IBEW, NCCER, or a local trade school.
Learn safety, wiring, blueprints, and installation basics from mentors.
After the apprenticeship, obtain the relevant licence and consider a specialism such as solar, EV charging, or smart home systems.
Join trade communities or unions and build relationships for jobs and referrals.
After gaining experience, consider project management or starting a contracting business.

tactics.name: Create a digital marketing portfolio
steps: Take free certifications from Google, HubSpot Academy, or Meta Blueprint.
Try short-form video, social posts, SEO, and simple websites to find a suitable specialism.
Offer free or low-cost help to local businesses or creators.
Share before-and-after examples, growth numbers, and case studies on LinkedIn, Instagram, or Upwork.
Choose a specialism such as personal branding, content creation, or social media management.
Once clients are consistent, use automation tools or freelancers to save time.

tactics.name: Build and demonstrate a small AI automation
steps: Learn AI and automation basics through beginner courses.
Try free tools such as ChatGPT, Zapier, Make, and Notion AI on simple tasks.
Build a small project, such as automating social posts or generating marketing ideas for a small business.
Show screenshots and explain the time or money saved compared with manual work.
Create a portfolio and offer services on Upwork, Fiverr, or LinkedIn.
Start with low-cost projects to build reviews, then package work as consulting to find and fix business bottlenecks.

tactics.name: Choose a path and act consistently
steps: Pick one path to focus on for the next 30 days.
Watch tutorials and apply what you learn immediately.
Expect the first paid client or project to take time; keep learning and taking consistent action.

quote.text: There is no overnight success. It's not about where you start. It's about how fast you learn and how consistently you take action.
quote.speaker: Casper Capital host (name not stated)
